title: Device twin desired configuration v1
description: Desired properties patch delivered through IoT Hub twin. Used only for thresholds, report interval and version. It never confirms a command, never opens doors and never changes security mode. The legacy lightingMode field must be ignored with a warning/diagnostic and must not overwrite the locally stored lighting_mode.

agentConfiguration.description: Allowed configuration keys. Additional keys cause rejection of the whole patch.

lightingMode.description: LEGACY. Must be ignored with a warning/diagnostic. The device stores lighting_mode only through SetLightingMode commands.
